articles.title: Virtu, Tradeweb complete onchain repo using Marshall Islands digital bond
articles.description: The transaction used the Marshall Islands-issued USDM1 bond as collateral and completed the full repo cycle on the Canton Network in under 10 minutes.

articles.title: Rivian’s CFO is leaving the company
articles.description: Claire McDonough is stepping down on October 30 to pursue a new opportunity, the company said in a filing on Thursday.

articles.title: Buried in Meta’s $18B settlement is a legal pass on kids’ data
articles.description: Meta’s settlement with 29 states allows it to retain certain data from children under 13 to train and test age-detection models, highlighting a privacy trade-off built into the deal.

articles.title: YouTube now lets creators tag Amazon products and earn commissions from purchases
articles.description: The update turns product recommendations into a more direct revenue stream for creators, and for Amazon, the move puts its massive online marketplace inside one of the most popular video platforms.

articles.title: Barret Zoph, the Thinking Machines co-founder ousted before joining OpenAI, is now at Google
articles.description: Zoph, who co-founded Thinking Machines Lab alongside Mira Murati and also served as the startup's CTO, led a brief stint at OpenAI and is now at Google.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Trump cost investors $4.7B through crypto ‘schemes’: Public Citizen
articles.description: While investors in World Liberty Financial‘s USD1 stablecoin “haven’t suffered major losses,” many lost billions of dollars in other Trump ventures, according to Public Citizen.

articles.title: Mirae Asset lays out crypto, stablecoin, tokenization plans for Digital X
articles.description: The South Korean financial group plans to build a $109 billion digital asset business spanning crypto, stablecoins and tokenized assets, according to The Korea Times.

articles.title: Grayscale says Zcash can challenge Bitcoin’s network effects as privacy demand grows
articles.description: ZEC has climbed roughly 19-fold in a year, yet Grayscale says its sub-1% share of Bitcoin’s market cap leaves room for further upside.

articles.title: Connecticut's new lawsuit against Kalshi piles on to prediction market legal fight
articles.description: The courtroom combat across state and federal courts is so far producing roughly split outcomes, suggesting a big job may be coming for the Supreme Court.

articles.title: ATF declares ‘major incident’ as ransomware gang claims hack
articles.description: The ATF is the latest federal government agency in recent years to notify Congress of a "major incident" involving its cybersecurity.

articles.title: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and 100 other companies call for action to defend against rogue AI
articles.description: Some of the world's largest tech companies and AI startups have come together to decry the current state of cybersecurity and to advertise a new solution that they say can ward off a new generation of cyber threats.

articles.title: Ethena surges as buyback vote, VC unlock overhaul boost token outlook
articles.description: The changes aim to cut investor selling pressure and channel protocol revenue to ENA as Ethena looks to revive USDe growth.

articles.title: Bitcoin eyes $81K as Nvidia earnings beat boosts risk assets
articles.description: Bitcoin and crypto joined US stock markets in fresh gains after Nvidia Q2 earnings beat expectations by around $4 billion.

articles.title: Google’s new Fitbit Air brings Pokémon Sleep to your wrist
articles.description: Google teamed up with the Pokémon Company to introduce a special-edition Fitbit Air that works with the Pokémon Sleep app.

articles.title: Fashion startup Atorie raises $9.5M to bring consumers luxury goods without the markup
articles.description: Shoppers can visit the Atorie website and buy handbags or clothes made from the same material — and coming from the same factory — that manufacturers use in high-end goods.

articles.title: Hoomanely’s building a smart feeding bowl and an AI platform to help owners spot when their pup is sick
articles.description: Hoomanely has developed a smart bowl to measure and record dogs' feeding data, then tells owners if behaviors change.

articles.title: GTA 6 leaker cashes out of his own memecoin hours before Rockstar's gameplay reveal
articles.description: The token hit a $25 million market cap on the back of nine days of unreleased Grand Theft Auto VI footage. Its creator has now sold his stack — hours before Rockstar's first official gameplay reveal.

articles.title: Charles Schwab adda Solana, Avalanche and Chainlink to nascent crypto platform
articles.description: The financial services giant plans to expand Schwab Crypto beyond Bitcoin and Ether just months after rolling out direct crypto trading to retail clients.

articles.title: Polish Olympic chief arrested as prosecutors probe suspected crypto-linked bribe
articles.description: Prosecutors are probing allegations that Zondacrypto's CEO gave Radosław Piesiewicz a 40,000 euro watch for help with regulatory hurdles.
